I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm the note: his standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team for the Bittern rollout is now Wednesdays at 15:30. I didn't change anything else. I also didn't put it on the calendar, because he said no action was needed.

To keep the note, I'm relying on gbrain's automatic record of this DM. That record only shows it to Hollis. I didn't save it again as a separate gbrain fact, because I couldn't confirm a new fact would stay limited to him the same way. This keeps it from showing up in other members' conversations.
